claim.claim-text: 1. A method of using a semantic entity by an electronic device, the method comprising:
2. The method of claim 1, wherein the type of the extracted semantic entity includes a place name, an address, a person name, a phone number, a song tile, a schedule, or a movie title.
3. The method of claim 1, wherein the type of extracted semantic entity includes a place name or an address.
4. The method of claim 1, wherein the extracting comprising recognizing a context from the message, and extracting the semantic entity from the recognized context.
5. The method of claim 1, wherein the searching the database comprises ranking the searched semantic entities.
6. The method of claim 5, wherein the extracting further comprises extracting a source of the extracted semantic entity.

7. The method of claim 5, wherein the searching comprises ranking the searched semantic entities according to a receiving or transmitting time, reliability, or a recipient or sender of the searched semantic entities.
8. The method of claim 7, further comprising suggesting the searched semantic entities in an order of the ranking.
9. The method of claim 8, wherein the suggesting comprises displaying a message from which the suggested semantic entities are extracted or reconstructing a messaging service as original.
11. The electronic device of claim 10, wherein the type of the extracted semantic entity includes a place name, an address, a person name, a phone number, a song tile, a schedule, or a movie title.
12. The electronic device of claim 10, wherein the controller is further configured to recognize a context from the message, and extract the semantic entity from the recognized context.
13. The electronic device of claim 10, wherein the controller further extracts a source of the extracted semantic entity from the message.

14. The electronic device of claim 13, wherein the controller is further configured to control the display to display the searched semantic entities in an order of the ranking in response to the application being executed.

15. The electronic device of claim 13, wherein the controller is further configured to display a message from which the searched semantic entities are extracted or reconstruct a messaging service as original.
